payload.description: ONE compact low heap of MIXED TYPES OF BONE FRAGMENTS for a pixel-art dungeon tactics game. Inside this ONE heap every bone has a DIFFERENT silhouette: one long thick broken shaft, two short thin splinters, one curved arc fragment, one flat irregular chipped shard, one knobbly joint stump and one short angular chunk. Seven to nine overlapping pieces total. Mix long and short, thick and thin, curved and flat pieces TOGETHER in one connected mound. Do NOT repeat identical cartoon dog bones. No separate clusters, ring or neat arrangement. Bare anonymous bones, impossible to tell human or monster. NO skull, face, eye holes, jaw, teeth, pelvis, complete rib cage, hands, feet, claws, horns, upright plate, flesh or blood. Simple crisp chunky native 64x64 pixel sprite; visible heap about 48x28 pixels. Only 8-10 muted dirty ivory, taupe and purple-gray flat colors; selective dark outline. Shallow three-quarter overhead camera, light top left. Very low wide silhouette. Transparent background. No floor, pedestal, debris outside the heap, soft shadows, glow, antialiasing, gradients, detailed surface texture, lettering or watermark. The pile is mostly SHORT DIFFERENT fragments: broad flat triangular chip, squat irregular joint lump, short block-like snapped end, thin straight splinter, ONE tiny curved arc, and only ONE longer narrow shaft. Mixed lengths and widths. Absolutely NO repeated arcs, NO parallel ribs, NO backbone or rib cage; no recognizable skeleton. One low connected mound.
